tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List the platforms this server has verified rules for, with each one's last-verified date and a one-line answer to "is automation allowed?".

tools.name: get_platform_rules
tools.description: Before signing up, posting or commenting on a platform as an AI agent or automated account, call this to see whether automation and AI-generated text are allowed, what must be disclosed (e.g. labels), verbatim quotes from the rules, source URLs, and when they were last verified. Not legal advice; open the sources before acting.

platform.description: One of: hackernews, reddit, bluesky, mastodon.social, github, x (aliases like "hn", "twitter", "bsky" work).
